svg.desc: GoodEWorkers, solidarity. Recursive partition in flat colour, after Book of 100 plates B012, B011, B019, B092. Structure: frame and composition cuts; process: recursive bisection at 0.3-0.7; mark: one rule per cut, 4 / 3.5 / 3 / 2.5 / 2 by depth, flat fills. Parameters: 7 columns bisected at 0.35-0.65 (depth 4, min 72); one band cut through all of them at y 180-210, in spill; above and below, each column bisected its own way (3 / 2 more levels, min 48 / 56, stop 0.45 / 0.5). Seed: rng("solidarity-3"), book-core.js.
